title: Case: Shipment tracking has not updated after depot arrival
context: Tracking stopped at the arrival scan, so the depot must locate the actual parcel rather than repeat the public tracking status.
initial_request: The tracker has not changed since early this morning. Could someone check whether the parcel is actually at the depot?

events.body: DL-2173 last public scan: destination depot arrival at 06:15 UTC on 2028-02-10. No sort or route scan is visible. Our system does not currently confirm the storage position.
The tracker has not changed since early this morning. Could someone check whether the parcel is actually at the depot?

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the destination depot for a physical scan and shipment location.

must_not: A physical depot scan is not proof of dispatch or delivery.
expected.reference_message: Please physically locate DL-2173 and provide a new scan with its storage position. The existing arrival status alone does not answer Quillon’s question.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-011: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The escalation arrives by Email instead of Customer portal; replying on either channel is accepted. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
